verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a project and issue-tracking tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no whiteboard or canvas feature in Linear. Documents, comments on images in issue descriptions, and the Figma integration for linking issues are adjacent features, not a shared visual whiteboard, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
